name: Cutlets of Sweetbreads à la Victoria
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Chop the sweetbreads, of which there should be two cups; if not enough, add chopped mushrooms to make two cups, then season.
Add egg, slightly beaten, to sauce, and combine mixtures.
Make a cut in small end of each cutlet, and insert in each a piece of cold boiled macaroni one and one-half inches long.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
